claims.label_ro: ca unitate de durată, are șaizeci de minute
claims.rationale: BIPM V4.01 Table8 explicitly defines the duration hour as60minutes; primary Romanian textbook lesson independently teaches this coefficient. The caption qualifies duration, excluding a clock reading or school lesson. Existing inverse de8214 already gives the same conversion; the proposed forward arc is missing and contributes directed reachability only, not a new conversion fact.

claims.label_ro: ca unitate de durată, are douăzeci și patru de ore
claims.rationale: BIPM V4.01 Table8 defines the duration unit day as24hours; primary Romanian lesson teaches this coefficient. The explicit duration-unit caption does not universalize elapsed local civil dates, daylight spans, UTC/calendar phenomena, months or years. Desired Zi→Oră is missing; inverse de7959 is only the existing generic unit association. Stored direction and caption are factually consistent without claiming a newly discovered conversion.

forms.rationale: Exact normative lemma observed in the official rendered DOOM entry. Both directly read institutional academic texts explicitly pair Ceas/Ceasornic by shared object denotation. Current deck and incident-edge meanings identify this owner as the physical time-indicating instrument; no hour-duration or botanical owner is reassigned.

Official rendered DOOM explicitly gives this neuter plural. Same qualified instrument sense and owner; this is one inflectional input form, not a second independent synonym family. No article/genitive/dative form is added.

lexical_families.rationale: Direct academic semantic pairing goes beyond morphology alone; the existing three clock deck roles and current source node/edge identity fit the instrument interpretation. Both selected bare forms are free in exact current normalization. Genuine lexical-family count is one; plural is morphology. Plant, hour/occasion, component-mechanism and unproven universal subtype meanings remain excluded. Optional-input coverage preserves familiar displayed Ceas; this does not prove population recognition or enjoyment.

qualifications: Only ceasornic/ceasornice are accepted as exact selected forms. Four article/case forms, orologiu and clipă/moment remain unselected or held; this review does not broaden them.
The botanical Passiflora use is real counterexample evidence; no plant meaning or unseen botanical owner is erased. Ceas hour/occasion meaning remains distinct from the existing instrument owner.
Defined duration conversion factors never imply a fixed calendar-month/year length or an unconditional civil/daylight interval. Minute/hour/day remain non-SI units; second is the SI time base unit.
Two new stored directions over existing unordered endpoint pairs are reachability growth, not two newly discovered facts or synonyms.
